id: 01_Laboratory Safety Protecting Lives with Emergency Response Preparedness
title: 应急准备：有备才能无患
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/01_Laboratory Safety Protecting Lives with Emergency Response Preparedness.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/01_Laboratory Safety Protecting Lives with Emergency Response Preparedness/src.py

points.K1: 意外难免，先做最坏准备
points.K2: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、过热
points.K3: 监测容许暴露限值和阈限值
points.K4: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
points.K6: 资源一：安全技术说明书
points.K7: 资源二：化学卫生计划和暴露控制计划
points.K9: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，门旁有安全出口标志和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway next to an emergency exit sign and a wall-mounted fire extinguisher, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室的应急准备。
overlay: 应急准备：有备才能无患

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 报警器、文件夹、洗眼器三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a ceiling alarm detector, a blank binder and an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 预警、资料、演练，一样都不能少。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰第一天到实验室，直接走向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at a lab on his first day and heads straight for a bench, putting on a lab coat.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，就想马上开工。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向墙上的洗眼器和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研问他：真出事了，你知道怎么办吗？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark floating above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰答不上来。

shots.section_title: 意外难免，先做最坏准备
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地竖起手指，身后是整洁的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face in front of a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 再怎么小心，总有出岔子的时候。
overlay: 意外难免，先做最坏准备

shots.section_title: 意外难免，先做最坏准备
shots.scene: 一面盾牌图标挡在警示三角前
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon standing in front of a yellow warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要按最坏的情况来准备。

shots.section_title: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、过热
shots.scene: 天花板上的探测器发出提示光
shots.prompt_en: A white ceiling-mounted detector glows with a small blinking light in a lab ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 自动早期预警系统是最理想的。
overlay: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、过热

shots.section_title: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、过热
shots.scene: 墙上的火灾报警按钮和天花板探测器
shots.prompt_en: A red wall-mounted fire alarm pull station beside a lab door, with a ceiling detector above. No people.
shots.narration: 它们一直在替你盯着实验室。

shots.section_title: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、过热
shots.scene: 一氧化碳、烟雾、温度计三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a gas molecule cloud, a puff of grey smoke and a thermometer with a high reading. No people.
shots.narration: 监测一氧化碳、烟雾和过热。

shots.section_title: 监测容许暴露限值和阈限值
shots.scene: 气体探测仪上的指针接近红色区域
shots.prompt_en: A blank gas detector panel with a needle gauge approaching a red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 还要监测你所用物质的暴露限值。
overlay: 监测容许暴露限值和阈限值

shots.section_title: 监测容许暴露限值和阈限值
shots.scene: 两条水平限值线，浓度曲线始终在线下
shots.prompt_en: A simple chart with two horizontal red limit lines and a green curve staying below them. No people.
shots.narration: 也就是容许暴露限值和阈限值。

shots.section_title: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
shots.scene: 天花板通风管道，箭头表示空气流动
shots.prompt_en: Lab ceiling ventilation ducts with blue arrows showing air flowing in and out. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室通风通常要一直开着。
overlay: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜

shots.section_title: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
shots.scene: 房间图标里空气循环箭头转了好几圈
shots.prompt_en: A lab room icon with circular arrows looping several times to show repeated air changes. No people.
shots.narration: 每小时把整屋空气全面换好几次。

shots.section_title: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前操作，屋顶风口也在排风
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a fume hood while ceiling vents also draw air from the whole room.
shots.narration: 排风不能光指望通风柜。

shots.section_title: 应急的四项必备资源
shots.scene: 欣欣伸出四根手指，身旁浮现四张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four fingers beside four floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 应急的事说不完，先记住四项资源。

shots.section_title: 资源一：安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白说明书，上面有危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet booklet showing hazard pictograms in red diamonds.
shots.narration: 第一项：安全技术说明书。
overlay: 资源一：安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 资源一：安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 阿杰坐在桌前认真翻阅说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk carefully reading a blank data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 它信息最全，前几课也反复提过。

shots.section_title: 资源二：化学卫生计划和暴露控制计划
shots.scene: 书架上两本空白文件夹，分别有烧瓶和口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with two blank binders, one marked with a flask icon and one with a respirator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二项：各种操作计划。
overlay: 资源二：化学卫生计划和暴露控制计划

shots.section_title: 资源二：化学卫生计划和暴露控制计划
shots.scene: 老周戴着半面罩和护目镜，翻开文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man wearing a half-face respirator and safety goggles opens a blank binder.
shots.narration: 比如化学卫生计划、暴露控制计划。

shots.section_title: 资源三：应急响应预案
shots.scene: 红色警示灯在蓝色光线下闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A red warning beacon flashing in dim blue light above a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 第三项超级重要：应急响应预案。

shots.section_title: 资源三：应急响应预案
shots.scene: 小研在资料架前翻开一份空白预案
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips open a blank emergency plan binder in front of a document rack.
shots.narration: 它写明本岗位、本场所的处置程序。

shots.section_title: 资源三：应急响应预案
shots.scene: 台面小火、液体溢洒、手指割伤三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a small flame on a bench, a spilled liquid puddle, and a cut finger. No people.
shots.narration: 台面着火、溢洒、割伤，统统都有。

shots.section_title: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练
shots.scene: 王老师在墙边给四名学生讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains something by a lab wall to four students in lab coats listening.
shots.narration: 第四项：去找你的导师或安全员。
overlay: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练

shots.section_title: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练
shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station, an eyewash station sign above it.
shots.narration: 他们会带你演练怎么找、怎么用洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练
shots.scene: 安全淋浴拉杆和安全淋浴标志
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower with a pull handle under a safety shower sign in a lab corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 还有安全淋浴。

shots.section_title: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练
shots.scene: 小研从墙上取下灭火毯包
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls a fire blanket out of a wall-mounted pouch.
shots.narration: 还有灭火毯。

shots.section_title: 资源四：找导师或安全员演练
shots.scene: 阿杰在王老师指导下手持灭火器练习
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a fire extinguisher during a training drill while the safety administrator watches beside him.
shots.narration: 还有灭火器。

shots.section_title: 不想遇到，但要准备好
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁通道里，四周设施齐全
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a clear lab corridor with an eyewash station, a safety shower and a fire extinguisher around.
shots.narration: 谁都不想碰上这种场面。

shots.section_title: 不想遇到，但要准备好
shots.scene: 阿杰自信地指出洗眼器和灭火器的位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student confidently points to the eyewash station and the fire extinguisher while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 但准备好了，总比手忙脚乱强。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现报警器和通风图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a ceiling detector and ventilation arrows.
shots.narration: 自动预警要有，通风要一直开。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 说明书、文件夹、预案、演练四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each with a green check: a data sheet, a binder, an emergency plan and a training drill. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书、计划、预案、演练，四项必备。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera at a lab doorway with a clear corridor behind.
shots.narration: 有备无患，我们下次见！
